title: Topics in Syntax; Wh-questions Around the World
description:
Prerequisite: LING311

Ways that wh-questions can be asked in human languages. Current theories of the nature of dependencies, diagnostics for movement, conclusions about what kinds of syntactic dependencies UG makes available. Phenomena covered: wh-fronting, wh-in-situ, long wh-movement, partial wh-movement, wh-copying, island-insensitive resumption, island-sensitive resumption, echo-questions, and multi-sentence questions.
